title: PRD-13 synthetic risk input syntax

buildingRef.description: required; authorized building/address. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: BUILDING_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

equipmentIdentifier.description: required; 1–100 NFC characters, unique within building. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ELEVATOR_IDENTIFIER_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

capacityPersons.description: conditional by equipment type; 1–10000 technical bound. Sensitivity: internal. Error: CAPACITY_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

capacityKg.description: required; 1–1000000 technical bound. Sensitivity: internal. Error: CAPACITY_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

stopCount.description: required; 1–1000 technical bound. Sensitivity: internal. Error: STOP_COUNT_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

maintenanceEvidenceRef.description: conditional by carrier; current agreement/service evidence. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: MAINTENANCE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

inspectionEvidenceRef.description: conditional before issue; approved provider inspection with expiry. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: INSPECTION_EXPIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

limitOption.description: required; offered per-person/per-event basis. Sensitivity: financial. Error: LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
